create_HtaConfig_from_file: create an HtaConfig instance from a JSON config file path to load trace analyzer settings
get_config_with_dot_path: get a nested configuration value using dot notation like c.c2.c21 from an HtaConfig instance
test_HtaConfig_default_paths: test that HtaConfig.get_default_paths returns three default config file paths ending with trace_analyzer.json
get_HTAEnvOptions_singleton: get the HTAEnvOptions singleton instance to read and modify environment-based trace analysis options
set_disable_ns_rounding_option: set the disable_ns_rounding option on HTAEnvOptions to control nanosecond precision trace rounding behavior
